body: Windows node window (hall9k-ce), 15:2x EDT: v0.10.1 installed. Brian clarified the restart rule in the node window (only the daemon's own in-flight action blocks a restart; detached agent sessions do not), so h9k update --restart ran at 15:19:54 EDT under two live hall9k builds. Stopped pid 3736, started pid 36732, h9k --version 0.10.1, daemon status shows it; catch-up adopted 4 runs, 0 orphaned, both build agents (a56cf16e pid 37308, 5c46cd1d pid 34244) alive and adopted in Running. No .new recipe files. The three-a-minute 'own ledger has no key yet' warnings for arx-platform, bioage-calc and hall9k-smoke are unchanged on 0.10.1.
